findings.claim: pedalboard 0.9.24 can be used as the VST3 host.
findings.verifiedBy: pedalboard is GPL-3.0. It runs in this standalone worker process and is reached over HTTP; the platform's TypeScript never links or bundles it. services/music-ai-worker already ships pedalboard 0.9.24 under the same process boundary, so this introduces no new licence posture.

findings.claim: The worker can host the operator's Steinberg instruments.
findings.verifiedBy: On the development workstation, pedalboard loads Retrologue 2.4.0 and Padshop as instruments when given the inner binary path (Contents/x86_64-win/*.vst3). Given the bundle folder it fails with 'unsupported plugin format or scan failure' -- the cause of the earlier assumption that a separate native host was required. HALion Sonic and Groove Agent SE were not probed beyond the bundle-path failure.

findings.claim: No plugin, preset or content library is redistributed.
findings.verifiedBy: The asset manifest lives in a git-ignored directory; responses expose asset id, identity string and SHA-256 digests only (host.asset_public_fields); /health replaces binary paths with '<private>'.

findings.claim: Rendered audio may be used by the operator.
findings.verifiedBy: Plugin vendor EULAs govern bounced audio; the operator's licence, not the platform's, applies. The worker attaches an attribution string to every render and smoke proof and asserts no rights in the output.

commercialUseNote: Subject to the operator's own plugin licences.
